title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
summary: We present GLM-5V-Turbo, a step toward native foundation models for multimodal agents. As foundation models are increasingly deployed in real environments, agentic capability depends not only on language reasoning, but also on the ability to perceive, interpret, and act over heterogeneous contexts such as images, videos, webpages, documents, GUIs. GLM-5V-Turbo is built around this objective: multimodal perception is integrated as a core component of reasoning, planning, tool use, and execution, …
description: multimodal agents, multimodal perception, foundation models, visual tool use, hierarchical optimization
developer_name: V Team, Wenyi Hong, Xiaotao Gu, Ziyang Pan, Zhen Yang et al. (78 authors)

title: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents
summary: Claw-style environments support multi-step workflows over local files, tools, and persistent workspace states. However, scalable development around these environments remains constrained by the absence of a systematic framework, especially one for synthesizing verifiable training data and integrating it with agent training and diagnostic evaluation. To address this challenge, we present ClawGym, a scalable framework that supports the full lifecycle of Claw-style personal agent development. Concr…

To address this challenge, we present ClawGym, a scalable framework that supports the full lifecycle of Claw-style personal agent development.
